description:
Insurance Board of Sri Lanka - Rules made to amend the Insurance Board of Sri Lanka Rules of 2005 published in Gaz.Ex. No. 1412/30 of 29.09.2005 by 
substitution for Rule 5
reasoning: This gazette content contains rules made by the Insurance Board of Sri Lanka under the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No. 43 of 2000. It specifically amends existing rules regarding the registration requirements for insurance brokers. This falls under the Legal/Regulatory category as it deals with regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and amendments to existing regulations governing the insurance industry.
